name: quantum-flip
description: Quantum Flip: a free-to-play on-chain coin-flip game on the QoreChain testnet (qorechain-diana). Every flip is an EVM transaction admitted only inside a post-quantum authorisation window, so each move is quantum-safe by construction.

scripts.compile: npx solc@0.8.24 --optimize --abi --bin -o out contracts/QuantumFlip.sol && node scripts/build-artifact.mjs
